scope: Current factual package for the 40-task Wilderness Achievement Diary. It proposes normalized actions and graph nodes only; it does not alter production data, make a route, assign risk or utility preferences, or infer a player's PvP or PvM readiness.

included: locations and Wilderness-level context where material

source_catalog.use: Current task list, stated skill/item/quest requirements, boost rule, rewards, tier claim rule, and January 2026 diary-gated boss-lair changes.
Global task-order, preceding-tier claim, and lamp rules.
PvP-area boundary, Resource Area facts, current boss-lair categories, deep/lesser boss Wilderness-level ranges, transport context, and Wilderness Slayer Cave/Revenant Cave boundaries.
Resource Area fee, furnace/anvil, dark-crab, tree, ore, and runite-golem context.
Course location and temporary-boost entry detail.
Calvar'ion lair level 21, fee, hard-diary/boss-Slayer exception, and 2026 change history.
Venenatis Silk Chasm level 35, medium-diary/boss-Slayer access condition, and ironman drop-eligibility boundary.
Current classification: Callisto, Venenatis, Vet'ion in multi-way level 35-40; Artio, Spindel, Calvar'ion in singles-plus level 21-29; overworld boss levels.
Crazy Archaeologist, Chaos Fanatic, Scorpia locations and collection-log context; this package grants no drops or log entries.

global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: Claiming a tier requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier. Claims are made from Lesser Fanatic east of the Edgeville jailhouse, outside the Wilderness.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts are allowed unless a task explicitly says otherwise. The fallen-Ent yew-log task explicitly requires 61 Woodcutting and is not boostable.
global_rules.pvp_boundary: The Wilderness is a PvP area except Ferox Enclave, Mage Arena bank, Corporeal Beast's Lair, and King Black Dragon Lair. Being in a PvP area establishes exposure only; it does not establish survival, escape, combat readiness, another player's availability, or a result.
global_rules.encounter_boundary: A diary task that requires a kill, successful hit, successful catch, successful harvest, or player interaction is player-confirmed. No normalized action may auto-complete those events from skills, equipment, access, or diary ownership.
global_rules.resource_area_fees: Base entry is 7500 coins; claiming medium lowers it to 6000, hard to 3750, and elite makes entry free. A task can still be completed before its prior-tier reward is claimed by paying the applicable higher fee.
global_rules.boss_lair_access: As checked, the greater Callisto/Venenatis/Vet'ion lairs require medium Wilderness Diary claimed or the matching boss Slayer task; lesser Artio/Spindel/Calvar'ion require hard Wilderness Diary claimed or the matching greater-boss Slayer task. These access exceptions do not make the corresponding elite kill task deterministic. The elite task's diary text accepts either variant for each family.
global_rules.proposed_task_transition: Each successful task action adds only that durable wilderness_diary_<tier>_<task> milestone. It does not add loot, kill counts, collection-log slots, combat readiness, player availability, PvP status, daily charges, or variable resource outputs.

normalization_proposal.rule: One action per task awards only that task milestone. Tier claims require all task milestones in their tier and claimed prior tiers, then award claimed-tier milestone, sword capability, lamp choice entitlement, and fixed capability flags. Daily claims, cooldowns, random rune contents, variable loot, boss drops, collection-log entries, PvP state, and risk outcomes remain unmodeled until dedicated account-state structures exist.
graph_edges: skill, quest, access, item, and player-confirmed encounter conditions -> task action (requires)
all task milestones plus preceding claimed tier -> tier claim action (requires)
tier claim -> claimed-tier milestone, sword, lamp entitlement, and concrete capabilities (produces)
medium/hard claim capability -> current boss-lair access condition; matching boss Slayer task is a separate alternative access node
account_state_requirements: quest/miniquest and Mage Arena spell-unlock state
normalization_proposal.encounter_boundary: All monster/boss kills, successful player hit, skill catches/harvests/thefts, and chained diary progress remain player-confirmed. No action should generate monster drops, resource yields, loot, collection-log entries, or economic value.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Boss-lair diary gates
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Older guides commonly state only a medium-diary gate for all six lairs. The current Wiki records January/February 2026 changes: greater lairs require medium claim or matching boss Slayer task; lesser lairs require hard claim or matching greater-boss Slayer task. This is recorded as a current access condition, not as an elite-task shortcut.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Lava-dragon task
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The current task is kill a lava dragon. The former bury-bones requirement was removed on 16 September 2023, so this package does not require or award bones.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Lundail quantities
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Historical official/community guides often list 10/20/30/50 daily random runes. The current diary lists 40/80/120/200 after the 30 August 2023 fourfold increase; current values are used.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Elite boss-family sequencing
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The named boss-family kills may occur in any order, but a different diary task update between them resets staged progress. This must be a dedicated staged-progress state, not three independently complete deterministic actions.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: PvP risk versus mechanics
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Wilderness levels and PvP-area facts are present to describe exposure. No source establishes a particular account's survival, risk tolerance, opponent availability, successful player hit, boss readiness, or safe extraction; these are intentionally not inferred.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Drops and collection log
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Bosses and chest/monster activities have variable outputs. The package does not award items, coins, collection-log progress, or Ironman drop eligibility from a diary task.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Community guide cross-check
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The OSRSToolkit entry is labelled community corroboration. Its static task/item summary was not used to override current Wiki mechanics or 2026 updates.
